name: Image Stage Drift Correction
description:
A time-lapse recording of a structure has suffered from camera drift. Your goal is to stabilize (register) the image stack so the features remain stationary.

1. Open the stack at '~/ImageJ_Data/raw/drifting_structure.tif'.
2. Use an appropriate registration method (e.g., Plugins > Registration > Correct 3D Drift, StackReg, TurboReg, or Template Matching) to align the frames.
3. Save the stabilized stack to '~/ImageJ_Data/results/stabilized_stack.tif'.

Note: The output must be a multi-frame stack where the object is stationary, not a single projection image.
